**BOHJ19N1** is the standardized Danish procedure code designating treatment with risankizumab [^src1]. As a newer biological therapy, it is classified under the broader category of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biological and targeted synthetic drugs) utilized in the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. 

According to Appendix Table 6 in the DANIBD 2025 report, BOHJ19N1 saw limited clinical application among both pediatric and adult patients during the reporting period from October 1, 2024, to September 30, 2025 [^src1]. The tracking of this specific code is part of a comprehensive national effort to document the use of advanced therapies and surgical interventions, forming the foundational evidence base for evaluating quality indicators 5 (biological treatment) and 6 (surgery) within the Danish IBD quality database [^src1].
